# Loïck Rivemale — Unity XR & Rendering Engineer

> Unity engineer specialising in XR, real-time rendering and technical art. 8+ years
> building production VR/AR applications and the systems behind them: GPU-based interaction,
> custom shader libraries and render features, worldspace VR UI toolkits, full-body motion
> capture. Based in France, works remotely. Open to freelance and contract work.
> Previously: Retinize (Animotive, 2020-2025), Airbus Defence & Space (Dragonfly, 2017-2020).

The homepage at https://loick.rivemale.space/ is an interactive Windows 98 desktop and requires JavaScript.
For the complete, plain-HTML career history, read /cv.html - it is the canonical source.

## My hall of fame
- **Airbus Group's VR visualizer**: Took part from early R&D through production and maintenance. Project: [Airbus DS](https://loick.rivemale.space/work/professional-experience/airbus-ds)
- **8K -> 4K lossless video pipeline**: Made a 360 video player allowing 8K video playback on low-end XR hardware. Project: [8K->4K compression pipeline](https://loick.rivemale.space/work/professional-experience/8k-4k-compression-pipeline)
- **VR UI Framework**: Built and maintained a UI/interaction system used for 3+ years in a commercial VR product. Project: [VR worldspace UI toolkit](https://loick.rivemale.space/work/professional-experience/vr-worldspace-ui-toolkit)
- **Millions of GPU raycasts <5ms**: Collider-free raycasting on static and animated geometry. Project: [Collider-free raycast system](https://loick.rivemale.space/work/professional-experience/collider-free-raycast-system)
- **End-to-end XR platform**: Built and maintained an AR application, its updater, asset pipeline and cloud/backend. Project: [XR freelancing](https://loick.rivemale.space/work/professional-experience/xr-freelancing)
